name: Shell
description: Shell scripting (Bash) is the universal glue of software engineering. It automates deployments, manages infrastructure, processes data pipelines, and controls the entire development toolchain. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: The Linux Command Line (William Shotts)
items.description: A comprehensive guide from basic keystrokes through advanced multi-file Bash shell scripts. Free PDF download.

items.title: Gregs Wiki — BashGuide
items.description: Considered the gold standard for learning proper Bash scripting with modern syntax, best practices, and anti-pattern avoidance.

items.title: Advanced Bash-Scripting Guide (TLDP)
items.description: The definitive deep-dive textbook for intermediate-to-advanced scripters covering complex data manipulation and system administration.

items.title: GNU Bash Reference Manual
items.description: The ultimate source of truth for Bash syntax, expansions, redirections, builtins, and parameter transformations.

items.title: ShellCheck — Static Analysis Tool
items.description: Indispensable real-time linter identifying syntax errors, quoting mistakes, and subtle bugs in Bash scripts.

items.title: Learn Shell (Interactive)
items.description: Free browser-based tutorial covering basic string operations, arrays, loops, conditionals, sed, and awk.

items.title: Codecademy — Linux & Bash Scripting
items.description: Free interactive tracks teaching file system navigation and automated workflows using shell scripts.

items.title: Complete Bash Scripting Course (YouTube)
items.description: A comprehensive full-length guide from beginner concepts to advanced production-grade Bash programming.

items.title: Bash Scripting Tutorials (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: Hands-on video tutorials covering Bash fundamentals, automation scripts, and system administration tasks.

items.title: Exercism — Bash Track
items.description: Coding exercises with automated analysis and human mentor feedback for writing robust shell scripts.

items.title: Cmdchallenge
items.description: A collection of shell challenges that test your ability to navigate and manipulate filesystems using CLI commands.

items.title: Devhints Bash Cheatsheet
items.description: The ultimate one-page reference for variables, strict modes, parameter expansions, string manipulation, and arrays.

items.title: ExplainShell.com
items.description: Write any shell command and get an instant breakdown of every flag, argument, and operator in plain english.

items.title: GNU Bash News
items.description: Official Bash mailing list tracking development, patches, and new feature announcements.

items.title: Reddit r/bash
items.description: Active community for scripting discussions, best-practice sharing, and troubleshooting.

items.title: Reddit r/bash
items.description: Active technical community focused on Bash scripting, troubleshooting, and code reviews.

items.title: Unix & Linux Stack Exchange
items.description: Premier Q&A for deep architectural inquiries, complex pipeline problems, and shell-specific nuances.

items.title: Stack Overflow — Bash Tag
items.description: Definitive forum for debugging shell scripts, quoting issues, and scripting best practices.
